correctness.rationale: For fixed alpha>-1, radial C^3 complex symbols f,g on full weighted order-two polyanalytic Bergman disk, decompose into one rank-one Fourier block and infinitely many rank-two blocks with beta(m+1,alpha+1) measure. Reconstruct the Jacobi offdiagonal b1^2=(alpha+1)(m+1)/[(m+alpha+2)^2(m+alpha+3)] and b2^2=2(alpha+2)(m+2)(m+alpha+2)/[(m+alpha+4)^2(m+alpha+3)(m+alpha+5)]. Exact compression yields [F_m(t),F_m(t^2)]=b1*b2^2 times skew 2x2 matrix, with m^3*b1*b2^2->2(alpha+2)sqrt(alpha+1). Taylor at t=1 and weighted beta moments bound cubic remainders O(m^-3), their commutators O(m^-4). For Delta=f'(1)g''(1)-f''(1)g'(1) !=0, two equal block singular values ~c*m^-3 where c=(alpha+2)sqrt(alpha+1)|Delta|; counting yields j^3*s_j->8c, Schatten iff p>1/3 and critical log sum 2*c^(1/3). Independently computed Jacobi beta moments for (alpha,m)=(0,0),(1/2,3),(2,8), all matching. Finite tests do not establish the full asymptotic.
